description.text: Objectives The master program in Engineering Mechanics aims to provide solid theory and technological knowledge to our students so that they will be able to engage in high level researching and teaching, and solve engineering problems. We encourage our students to be independent, innovative, and committed. After the program, student may find jobs in high tech companies, teaching and research institutions. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Biomechanics 2. Fracture Mechnaics 3. Computational Mechanics 4. Micro-nano Mechanics 5. Structural Mechanics 6. Elastic Dynamics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 33 credits.

duration.text: The Engineering Mechanics at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree 4) Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 5) Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) 6) Two letters of recommendation from two associate professors or higher

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Under the age of 35. 4. Have attained a Bachelor's diploma with good marks. 5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
